paper_title: UnionSparse is a sparse low-bit LLM inference framework optimized for small-batch edge GPU deployment on platforms such as Jetson AGX Orin and Jetson Thor, and can be integrated into inference frameworks such as TensorRT-LLM and FasterTransformer.

# UnionSparse ### An Index-Efficient Sparsity Framework for Low-Bit Sparse LLM Inference on Edge [REDACTED] [REDACTED] [REDACTED] [REDACTED] [Overview](#overview) · [Performance](#performance) · [Quick Start](#quick-start) · [Benchmarks](#kernel-benchmarks) · [End-to-End](#end-to-end-inference) · [Citation](#citation)
UnionSparse is a CUDA framework for low-bit, unstructured sparse LLM inference on edge GPUs. It co-designs a compact sparse representation with a Tensor Core SpMM kernel to reduce the metadata and payload-decoding overhead that dominates small-batch autoregressive inference. ## Overview

UnionSparse representation and execution framework. Click the figure to open the original vector PDF.

UnionSparse combines three ideas: - **Index-Efficient Bitmap Encoding (IE-BME)** groups low-bit payload regions behind a shared logical union bitmap, improving the payload-to-metadata ratio and regularizing sparse traversal. - **Decoupled Warp-Specialized Producer-Consumer (DW-PC)** overlaps tile prefetching with sparse decoding and Tensor Core computation. - **Low-Bit Shared-Memory Parallel Decoding (LSPD)** reconstructs Tensor-Core-ready fragments directly from the compressed shared-memory tile. The repository contains the CUDA SpMM library, INT4 and W2A4 kernel benchmarks, baseline integrations, model-conversion tools, and a FasterTransformer-based end-to-end inference path. ## Performance Experiments in the paper use a Jetson AGX Orin 64GB in MAX-N mode with JetPack 6.1, CUDA 12.6, GCC 11.4, and W4A4 quantization. The kernel corpus covers 832 cases drawn from LLaMA2-7B/13B, OPT-13B, Qwen2-7B, and LLaMA3-8B shapes across decode widths `N = 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32` and 40%-70% sparsity. | Kernel-level speedup | End-to-end OPT-13B throughput | |:--:|:--:| | | | | [Original vector PDF](docs/assets/readme/kernel-speedup.pdf) | [Original vector PDF](docs/assets/readme/end-to-end-performance.pdf) | Across the evaluation corpus, UnionSparse reports average kernel-level speedups of **2.30x over Flash-LLM**, **1.43x over SpInfer**, **1.56x over CUTLASS**, and **3.46x over cuBLAS Tensor Core**. On OPT-13B W4A4 inference, the measured throughput advantage reaches **2.40x-2.63x** across output lengths 64-1024 in the evaluated setup. > Performance depends on the matrix shape, sparsity, batch size, GPU architecture, and baseline configuration. Use the scripts below to reproduce results on your target platform. ## Requirements | Component | Tested configuration | |---|---| | Platform | Jetson AGX Orin 64GB, MAX-N mode | | OS | Ubuntu 22.04.5 LTS | | JetPack | 6.1 | | CUDA / NVCC | 12.6 / 12.6 | | Compiler | GCC 11.4 | | GPU architecture | SM87 by default | | Python | 3.9+ | You also need `git`, `cmake`, `wget`, OpenMPI, and the repository's bundled third-party dependencies. ```bash sudo apt update sudo apt install -y build-essential cmake wget openmpi-bin libopenmpi-dev ``` SparTA-related paths on Jetson/aarch64 additionally require the system cuSPARSELt package: ```bash sudo apt install -y cusparselt-cuda-12 libcusparselt0-dev-cuda-12 ``` For a GPU other than SM87, replace `87` in the build commands with the target SM, for example `80` for A100. ## Quick Start ### 1. Clone and create the environment ```bash git clone https://github.com/Victor-Alen/UnionSparse.git cd UnionSparse source Init_UnionSparse.sh conda create -n unionsparse python=3.9 -y conda activate unionsparse pip install cmake==3.30.3 numpy pandas matplotlib pyyaml safetensors torch seaborn ``` `Init_UnionSparse.sh` exports both `UnionSparse_HOME` and `UNIONSPARSE_HOME` to the repository root. ### 2. Prepare third-party dependencies The build expects these paths to exist: ```text third_party/FasterTransformer third_party/sputnik third_party/glog ``` Build the bundled `glog` and `sputnik`, then prepare cuSPARSELt: ```bash cd "$UnionSparse_HOME/third_party" CUDA_ARCHS=87 source build_sputnik.sh source preparse_cusparselt.sh ``` ### 3. Build UnionSparse ```bash cd "$UnionSparse_HOME/build" SMS=87 make -j ``` The core library is generated at `build/libSpMM_API.so`; its public header is `include/SpMM_API.cuh`. If CUDA is installed outside `/usr/local/cuda`, provide the toolkit explicitly: ```bash CUDA_PATH=/usr/local/cuda-12.6 SMS=87 make -j ``` ## Kernel Benchmarks Benchmark sources are organized into UnionSparse kernels, third-party operators, and Python analysis tools under `kernel_benchmark/`. ### INT4 / W4A4 ```bash cd "$UnionSparse_HOME/kernel_benchmark" source test_env SMS=87 make -j spmm_test_int4 spmm_test_cusparse spmm_test_sputnik spmm_test_sparta bash run_all_main_int4.sh ``` Useful sweep controls: ```bash ROUNDS=3 MAX_CASES=16 START_CASE=1 \ N_VALUES="2 4 8 16" SPARSITY_VALUES="40 50 60 70" \ bash run_all_main_int4.sh ``` Run UnionSparse against all bundled baselines: ```bash bash benchmark_unionsparse.sh # or a bounded run bash benchmark_unionsparse.sh --max-cases 16 --start-case 1 \ --summary-csv "$UnionSparse_HOME/kernel_benchmark/results/summary.csv" ``` Set `AUTO_BUILD=1` to rebuild the required binaries automatically. ### W2A4 W2A4 stores sparse weights as signed int2, keeps activations in int4, and reuses the UnionSparse bitmap layout and Tensor Core execution path. ```bash cd "$UnionSparse_HOME/kernel_benchmark" source test_env SMS=87 make -j spmm_test_w2a4 BENCH_WARMUP=1 BENCH_ITERS=1 AUTO_SPLITK_W2A4=0 \ ./spmm_test_w2a4 64 256 2 50 1 ROUNDS=3 MAX_CASES=16 START_CASE=1 \ N_VALUES="2 4 8 16" SPARSITY_VALUES="40 50 60 70" \ bash run_all_main_w2a4.sh ``` ## End-to-End Inference The end-to-end path uses an external FasterTransformer v5.1 tree and converted model weights. ```bash cd "$UNIONSPARSE_HOME" NATIVE_FT_ROOT=/path/to/native/FasterTransformer MODEL_DIR=/path/to/unionsparse-int4/1-gpu git clone https://github.com/NVIDIA/FasterTransformer.git "$NATIVE_FT_ROOT" git -C "$NATIVE_FT_ROOT" checkout release/v5.1_tag git -C "$NATIVE_FT_ROOT" submodule update --init --recursive bash "$UNIONSPARSE_HOME/third_party/prepare_external_ft_v51.sh" "$NATIVE_FT_ROOT" ``` Inspect the converter options and create a UnionSparse model directory: ```bash python "$UNIONSPARSE_HOME/end2end_inference/ft_tools/tllm_int4_to_unionsparse.py" --help ``` For W2A4 artifacts, pass `--weight-bits 2`: ```bash python "$UNIONSPARSE_HOME/end2end_inference/ft_tools/tllm_int4_to_unionsparse.py" \ --tllm-dir /path/to/tllm-checkpoint \ --output /path/to/unionsparse-w2a4/1-gpu \ --weight-bits 2 \ --force-quantize \ --write-lists ``` Run inference: ```bash MODEL_DIR="$MODEL_DIR" FT_ROOT="$NATIVE_FT_ROOT" \ bash end2end_inference/run_unionsparse_example.sh ``` For W2A4, point `MODEL_DIR` to the W2A4 artifact and set `UNIONSPARSE_W2A4=1`. The runner also accepts `FT_BUILD_DIR` and `CONFIG_TEMPLATE` overrides. See [End2end_Inference.md](end2end_inference/End2end_Inference.md) for the complete conversion and execution workflow. ## Repository Layout ```text UnionSparse/ ├── csrc/ # CUDA kernels and low-level utilities ├── include/ # Public C++/CUDA API ├── build/ # Core library build ├── kernel_benchmark/ # INT4/W2A4 benchmarks and analysis tools │ ├── unionsparse_core/ # UnionSparse benchmark kernels │ ├── third_party_ops/ # Baseline operator integrations │ └── python_tools/ # Data processing and plotting ├── end2end_inference/ # Conversion and FasterTransformer workflows ├── third_party/ # External runtimes, patches, and preparation scripts └── docs/ # Documentation and README assets ``` Benchmark CSVs, logs, and generated figures are written to `kernel_benchmark/results/` by default. ## Troubleshooting - Missing `build/libSpMM_API.so`: rerun `SMS=87 make -j` from `build/`. - Missing CUTLASS headers: verify `third_party/FasterTransformer/3rdparty/cutlass/include`. - Missing Sputnik or cuSPARSELt: rerun `third_party/build_sputnik.sh` and `third_party/preparse_cusparselt.sh`. - Missing FasterTransformer: set `FT_ROOT` to a prepared v5.1 checkout. - Missing model files: point `MODEL_DIR` to the final `.../1-gpu` directory. ## Citation If UnionSparse helps your research, please cite: ```bibtex @article{jiang2026unionsparse, title = {UnionSparse: An Index-Efficient Sparsity Framework for Low-Bit Sparse LLM Inference on Edge}, author = {Jiang, Tianhao and Gu, Hang and Wang, Teng and Cheng, Qianyu and Zheng, Zhendong and Tang, Cheng and Su, Qiyue and Lou, Wenqi and Gong, Lei and Wang, Chao and Li, Xi and Zhou, Xuehai}, journal = {IEEE Transactions on Computer-Aided Design of Integrated Circuits and Systems}, year = {2026} } ``` ## Acknowledgements UnionSparse builds on ideas and infrastructure from [SpInfer](https://github.com/HPMLL/SpInfer_EuroSys25), [Flash-LLM](https://github.com/AlibabaResearch/flash-llm), [FasterTransformer](https://github.com/NVIDIA/FasterTransformer), [CUTLASS](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cutlass), Sputnik, SparTA, and cuSPARSELt. ## License This project is released under the [Apache License 2.0](LICENSE).
